From memory, the one-shot in-memory Vamana index over the full billion-point dataset was built on an **Azure M64-32ms virtual machine with about 1792 GB (~1.75 TB) of RAM**. Building that single large index needed far more memory than the 64 GB workstation used for most of the other experiments.

I can't check the paper right now, so treat the exact VM name and RAM figure as likely but unverified. You can confirm them in the experimental setup or billion-scale evaluation section.
